Teachers say the new rules overburden them with paperwork.
老師們說新規定讓他們被文書工作壓得喘不過氣。

tarnished.zh: 失去光澤的；受損的（名聲）
ai: The old silver spoons were tarnished and needed polishing.
那些舊銀湯匙都失去光澤，需要擦亮。
The scandal left his tarnished reputation hard to repair.
這場醜聞讓他受損的名聲很難挽回。

tarnished.zh: 使失去光澤；玷污（tarnish 的過去式）
ai: Years of damp air tarnished the brass handle.
多年的潮濕空氣讓黃銅把手失去了光澤。
The lie tarnished her good name.
那個謊言玷污了她的好名聲。
Throwing a tantrum over a game is infantile.
為了一場遊戲鬧脾氣真是幼稚。
I'm tired of his infantile jokes.
我受夠了他那些幼稚的笑話。
The clinic treats infantile illnesses such as ear infections.
這家診所治療耳朵感染等嬰幼兒疾病。
Researchers study infantile development in the first year of life.
研究人員研究嬰兒出生第一年的發展。
Crabs and shrimp are both crustaceans.
螃蟹和蝦都是甲殼類動物。
The crustacean hid under a rock when the tide went out.
退潮時，那隻甲殼類動物躲到石頭底下。
The restaurant is famous for its crustacean dishes.
這家餐廳以甲殼類料理聞名。
She is allergic to crustacean proteins.
她對甲殼類蛋白質過敏。
The court ruled on the illegality of the contract.
法院就這份合約的違法性做出裁決。
Nobody questioned the illegality of selling fake tickets.
沒有人質疑販賣假票是違法的。
Blue hydrangeas bloom along the garden path every summer.
每年夏天，藍色繡球花沿著花園小徑盛開。
She cut a few hydrangea stems and put them in a vase.
她剪了幾枝繡球花放進花瓶。
In pursuance of his duties, he visited every branch office.
為了履行職責，他拜訪了每一間分公司。
The company acted in pursuance of the new safety rules.
公司依照新的安全規定行事。

philistine.zh: 庸俗的人；對藝術無知的人
ai: He called his neighbor a philistine for ignoring the art show.
他因為鄰居不理會藝術展，就說對方是個庸俗的人。
Only a philistine would paint over such a beautiful old mural.
只有庸俗的人才會把這麼美的古老壁畫塗掉。

philistine.zh: 庸俗的；缺乏文化素養的
ai: He dismissed jazz as a philistine pastime.
他把爵士樂貶為庸俗的消遣。
Critics attacked the philistine attitude toward the arts.
評論家抨擊那種輕視藝術的庸俗態度。

skittish.zh: 容易受驚的；神經緊張的
ai: The skittish horse jumped at every sudden noise.
那匹容易受驚的馬一聽到突然的聲音就跳起來。
Investors grew skittish after the bad news.
壞消息出來後，投資人變得神經緊繃。
Don't sit on the bed, you'll rumple the sheets.
別坐在床上，你會把床單弄皺。
The wind rumpled her hair as she rode her bike.
她騎車時，風把頭髮吹得凌亂。
A jackal howled somewhere in the dark desert.
黑暗的沙漠某處傳來胡狼的嚎叫。
Jackals often hunt in pairs or small groups.
胡狼常成對或結成小群獵食。
He received no recompense for the time he lost.
他的時間損失沒有得到任何補償。
The company offered recompense to every customer affected.
公司對每位受影響的顧客提出補償。
The airline will recompense passengers for the long delay.
航空公司會為這次長時間延誤補償乘客。
How can I ever recompense you for your kindness?
我要怎麼報答你的好意呢？

recovered.zh: 康復；找回（recover 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: She recovered quickly after the surgery.
她手術後恢復得很快。
The police recovered the stolen bike two days later.
警方兩天後尋回了被偷的腳踏車。
The recovered files were saved to a new drive.
救回的檔案被存到新的硬碟裡。
He is fully recovered and ready to return to work.
他已完全康復，準備回去上班。

pedantic.zh: 賣弄學問的；過分咬文嚼字的
ai: He gets pedantic about grammar and corrects everyone's emails.
他對文法很吹毛求疵，還會糾正每個人的電子郵件。
It may sound pedantic, but the report needs exact numbers.
這聽起來可能太過拘泥，但報告需要精確的數字。
Mechanized farming has greatly increased the amount of food we grow.
機械化農耕大幅提高了糧食產量。
The factory switched to a fully mechanized production line.
工廠改用全機械化的生產線。

mechanized.zh: 使機械化（mechanize 的過去式）
ai: The farm mechanized its harvest in the 1950s.
這座農場在一九五零年代將收成作業機械化。
They mechanized the packing process to save time.
他們把包裝流程機械化以節省時間。
The warm spring day gave us a foretaste of summer.
這個溫暖的春日讓我們先嘗到夏天的滋味。
The first test was a foretaste of the challenges ahead.
第一次測試預示了接下來的挑戰。
The old record was played in mono, not stereo.
那張老唱片是以單聲道播放，不是立體聲。
I prefer the mono version of the song for its simple sound.
我比較喜歡這首歌的單聲道版本，聲音很簡單。
The stagecoach carried mail and passengers across the plains.
驛馬車載著郵件和乘客穿越平原。
In old Western films, a stagecoach is often chased by bandits.
在老西部電影裡，驛馬車常被強盜追趕。
Separatism has been a sensitive issue in the region for decades.
幾十年來，分離主義一直是這個地區的敏感議題。
The book explores the history of separatism in Europe.
這本書探討歐洲分離主義的歷史。
In class we learned how to calculate the sine of an angle.
我們在課堂上學會怎麼計算角的正弦。
A sine wave looks like a smooth, repeating curve.
正弦波看起來像一條平滑重複的曲線。
A thunderbolt struck the old tree during the storm.
暴風雨中，一道雷電擊中了那棵老樹。
The loud thunderbolt made the baby cry.
那聲巨大的霹靂讓寶寶哭了起來。
The news of his resignation came like a thunderbolt.
他辭職的消息宛如晴天霹靂。
Her sudden decision to move abroad was a thunderbolt to her family.
她突然決定搬到國外，對家人來說猶如晴天霹靂。
The team held a quick powwow before the big match.
大賽前，球隊開了個簡短的討論會。
Let's have a powwow after lunch to plan the trip.
午餐後我們開個會討論這趟旅行。
The managers powwowed in the hall for an hour.
經理們在大廳商談了一個小時。
Let's powwow later and decide what to do.
我們晚點討論一下再決定怎麼做。

stretched.zh: 伸展；拉長（stretch 的過去式）
ai: She stretched her arms above her head and yawned.
她把雙臂伸過頭頂，打了個呵欠。
The rope stretched tight between the two trees.
繩子在兩棵樹之間拉得緊緊的。
Our budget is stretched this month because of the repairs.
因為維修費用，我們這個月的預算很吃緊。
The hospital's stretched staff are working long hours.
醫院人手吃緊的員工正在長時間工作。
The film brings back the style of yesteryear.
這部電影帶回了昔日的風格。
Stories of yesteryear are told in this small museum.
這間小博物館講述著往昔的故事。
A bevy of reporters waited outside the court.
一群記者在法院外等候。
She arrived with a bevy of friends carrying gifts.
她和一群帶著禮物的朋友一起抵達。
In old films, a patient is sometimes shown in a straitjacket.
在老電影裡，病人有時會被畫面呈現穿著拘束衣。
Strict rules put the company in a straitjacket and stopped new ideas.
嚴格的規定把公司綁手綁腳，扼殺了新點子。
Pandemonium broke out when the fire alarm went off.
火警響起時，現場一片大亂。
The classroom was in pandemonium after the teacher left.
老師離開後，教室裡亂成一團。
There is a common misapprehension that carrots give you perfect eyesight.
有個常見的誤解，以為吃胡蘿蔔就能讓視力變完美。
He was under the misapprehension that the shop was open on Sundays.
他誤以為這家店星期天有營業。
The hot weather left the dog feeling listless all afternoon.
炎熱的天氣讓狗整個下午都無精打采。
She felt listless after a week of poor sleep.
一週沒睡好之後，她覺得提不起勁。
Bees are the most important pollinators of many crops.
蜜蜂是許多農作物最重要的授粉者。
Planting flowers helps attract pollinators to your garden.
種花有助於吸引授粉昆蟲來到花園。
The actor has great comedic timing.
這位演員有絕佳的喜劇節奏感。
She wrote a comedic story about a clumsy waiter.
她寫了一個關於笨手笨腳服務生的喜劇故事。

jaundiced.zh: 抱持偏見的；憤世嫉俗的
ai: He takes a jaundiced view of every new idea.
他對每個新點子都抱持偏見的看法。
After years of broken promises, she looked at politics with a jaundiced eye.
多年來承諾落空，她以憤世嫉俗的眼光看待政治。
The newborn looked slightly jaundiced and stayed in the hospital.
那個新生兒看起來有點黃疸，所以留在醫院觀察。
A jaundiced skin color can be a sign of liver trouble.
皮膚發黃可能是肝臟出問題的徵兆。
Filling out the same form again was an irksome task.
又要再填一次同樣的表格，真是件煩人的事。
His irksome habit of tapping his pen drove me crazy.
他一直敲筆的討厭習慣快把我逼瘋了。
The cultural attache organized the art exhibit at the embassy.
文化專員在大使館籌辦了這場藝術展。
He works as a military attache in a foreign capital.
他在外國首都擔任武官。
The good news will hearten the whole team.
這個好消息會鼓舞整個團隊。
It heartened her to see so many people come to help.
看到這麼多人來幫忙，讓她大受鼓舞。
The mask was grotesquely large and covered half his body.
那個面具大得離譜，遮住了他半個身體。
The statue was grotesquely twisted, like a bad dream.
那座雕像扭曲得很怪誕，像一場惡夢。
The town showed great resiliency after the flood.
小鎮在水災後展現出強大的復原力。
Children often have a remarkable resiliency in hard times.
孩子在艱困的時期往往有驚人的韌性。
The horses were galloping across the open field.
馬群正在空曠的田野上疾馳。
We heard hooves galloping down the road.
我們聽到馬蹄聲沿著路飛奔而來。
Galloping prices made it hard for families to buy food.
飛漲的物價讓家庭很難買得起食物。
The doctor worried about the galloping spread of the infection.
醫生擔心感染快速擴散。
The fans exulted when the team scored in the last minute.
球隊在最後一分鐘得分時，球迷歡欣雀躍。
She exulted in her victory and hugged everyone.
她為自己的勝利欣喜若狂，擁抱了每一個人。
She wore a fringed jacket to the music festival.
她穿著一件有流蘇的外套去音樂節。
The lamp had a fringed shade in dark red.
那盞燈有個深紅色、帶流蘇的燈罩。
The lake is fringed with tall pine trees.
湖的四周圍繞著高大的松樹。
The beach, fringed by palms, was perfectly quiet.
被棕櫚樹環繞的海灘十分寧靜。

ebullient.zh: 熱情洋溢的；興高采烈的
ai: The ebullient host welcomed every guest with a big smile.
興高采烈的主人笑容滿面地迎接每一位客人。
She was in an ebullient mood after passing the exam.
通過考試後，她心情興高采烈。
A portly gentleman in a gray suit sat by the window.
一位身穿灰色西裝、身形發福的紳士坐在窗邊。
The portly chef tasted the soup and nodded.
矮胖的主廚嚐了嚐湯，點了點頭。
Her duplicity was exposed when the two stories didn't match.
兩個說法對不上時，她的表裡不一就被揭穿了。
He was shocked by the duplicity of his closest friend.
他對摯友的口是心非感到震驚。
He was seen in a disreputable part of town late at night.
有人看到他深夜出現在城裡名聲不好的地區。
The company has a disreputable history of cheating customers.
這間公司有欺騙顧客的不良紀錄。
The climber almost fell into a deep crevasse in the glacier.
那位登山者差點掉進冰河上的一道深裂縫。
Guides use ropes to cross a crevasse safely.
嚮導用繩索安全地越過冰河裂縫。
